items.definition:
agreement or harmony
The two sides reached an accord.

progress; promotion
Her rapid advancement in the company was impressive.

a positive declaration intended to give confidence; promise
He gave me his assurance that the work would be completed on time.

a punitive ban that forbids relations with certain groups, cooperation with a policy, or the handling of goods
Consumers organized a boycott of the company's products.

an oxide containing two atoms of oxygen in its molecule
Carbon dioxide is a greenhouse gas.

fate, typically a bad or unfortunate one; death, destruction, or any very bad end
The ancient prophecy spoke of a terrible doom.

the act or process of soliciting financial contributions
The charity organized a fundraising event to help the victims.

lack of fairness or justice
The civil rights movement fought against racial injustice.

a hormone produced in the pancreas that regulates the amount of glucose in the blood
Diabetic patients often need to take insulin injections.

large country house
The old manor house stood on a hill overlooking the village.

a work of outstanding artistry
The painting is considered a true masterpiece.

a person who narrates
The narrator's voice was calm and soothing.

the condition of being grossly fat or overweight
Childhood obesity is a growing concern.

a member or follower of any of the Western Christian Churches that are separate from the Roman Catholic Church
Many early settlers in America were Protestant.

dependence on or trust in someone or something
Our reliance on fossil fuels needs to decrease.

a title of the former monarch of Iran
The last Shah of Iran was overthrown in 1979.

a smoothbore firearm
He carried a shotgun for hunting.

the system of taxing people or things
The government is considering new policies on taxation.

a table or flat-topped block used as the focus for a religious ritual
The bride and groom stood before the altar.

the use of largely automatic equipment in a system of manufacturing or other production process
Automation has greatly increased efficiency in factories.

a feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder
The Grand Canyon filled them with awe.

soldiers who fought on horseback
The cavalry charged across the open field.

a long, narrow box, typically of wood, in which a dead body is buried or cremated
The coffin was lowered into the grave.

a limitation or restriction
We are working under severe time constraints.

a widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time
The city is facing an epidemic of flu cases.

infinite or unending time
They promised to love each other for eternity.

a style of swimming, wrestling, or skiing in which there are no rules regarding the method used
He won the gold medal in the freestyle swimming event.

the killing of one person by another
The police are investigating the homicide.

money or property received from someone after their death
She received a large inheritance from her grandmother.

an individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form
A single-celled organism can be seen under a microscope.

a person actively engaged in a profession, especially medicine
She is a general medical practitioner.

an expert or specialist in psychology
He decided to see a psychologist to help with his anxiety.

competition
There's a strong rivalry between the two teams.

members of a royal family
The queen is a member of the British royalty.

a short official statement
The news bulletin reported on the latest events.

police officer (UK)
The constable directed traffic around the accident.

action; legal document
He performed a good deed by helping the elderly woman.

a permanent item; a regular presence
The light fixture in the bathroom needs to be replaced.

practices conducive to maintaining health and preventing disease
Good personal hygiene is important for preventing illness.

a person who commits an illegal act
The police caught the offender near the scene of the crime.

preconceived opinion not based on reason or actual experience
It's important to fight against prejudice in society.

the release of an offender from detention, subject to a period of good behavior under supervision
He was given probation instead of a prison sentence.

an estimate or forecast of a future situation based on present trends
The company's sales projections look promising for next quarter.

rehabilitation (informal)
She went to rehab to recover from her injury.

a new version of an old film or song
The remake of the classic movie was very popular.

the action or process of making a copy of something
The museum displayed a perfect reproduction of the ancient vase.

a person who speaks on behalf of a group or organization
The company spokesman issued a statement to the press.

the things and conditions around a person or thing
The natural surroundings of the lake were breathtaking.

arrangement in a straight line
The wheels needed an alignment.

a complex machine or device
The laboratory apparatus was very expensive.

one who inflicts punishment in return for an injury or wrong
He sought to be an avenger for his family's honor.

perfect happiness
They were in a state of pure bliss.

a protective barrier
The trees acted as a buffer against the wind.

something that prevents someone from concentrating
The noise was a major distraction.

a biological community of interacting organisms and their physical environment
The rainforest is a complex ecosystem.

the ability to produce offspring or to produce abundant crops
The fertility of the soil is crucial for good harvests.

a system in which members of an organization or society are ranked according to relative status or authority
There is a clear hierarchy in the military.

a hard, typically green stone used for ornaments and implements and in jewelry
She wore a necklace made of jade.

an indentation or incision on an edge or surface
He cut a notch in the stick to mark the height.

the last letter of the Greek alphabet; the final part of a series
He considered himself the alpha and omega of the project.

an imitation of the style of a particular writer, artist, or genre with deliberate exaggeration for comic effect
The movie was a parody of classic horror films.

the release of a prisoner temporarily (for a special purpose) or permanently before the completion of a sentence, on the promise of good behavior
He was granted parole after serving half of his sentence.

a ghost; a figment of the imagination
She felt a phantom pain in her missing limb.

a person who replies to something
The respondent answered all the questions truthfully.
